name: character-studio
description: Start stylized humanoids with a reusable connected T-pose base, test its proportions and joints, then fit character details and GLB delivery in Blender.

interface.shortDescription: Create stylized low-poly characters in Blender
interface.longDescription: Includes a dedicated Character Base Body skill for a connected faceted T-pose mannequin, balanced/compact/sturdy proportions and joint-study poses. References can inspire original characters in the chosen house style. Fit clothing, face, hair and gameplay motion after reviewing the base. Retains the legacy dressed starter, robot/animal routes, character effects and local security protections.
defaultPrompt: Use Character Studio to design and build a stylized low-poly 3D character in Blender.
